prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Houston for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on your needs. Houston has many excellent implant providers (periodontists, oral & maxillofacial surgeons, and prosthodontists, plus some general dentists with advanced implant training). Instead of one name, here’s a short checklist and concrete next steps so you can find the best provider for your case.

Quick guidance
- For complex cases (jaw reconstruction, multiple implants, medical issues, extractions + immediate implants): look to an oral & maxillofacial surgeon (OMS).
- For bone/gum issues and grafting: a board‑certified periodontist.
- For the final tooth restoration where esthetics and bite are critical (especially full‑mouth or complex prosthetics): a prosthodontist.
- For a straightforward single implant, many well‑trained general dentists place great implants—experience and technology matter more than the title alone.

What to look for (quick checklist)
- Relevant specialty and board certification (ABOMS for OMSs, American Board of Periodontology for periodontists, American Board of Prosthodontics for prosthodontists).
- Years of implant experience and how many implants they place per year.
- On‑site CBCT (3D imaging) and use of guided implant planning.
- Before/after photos and patient references or reviews.
- Clear pricing and a written treatment plan (including grafts, temporary teeth, follow‑ups).
- Implant brands used (well‑known brands like Straumann, Nobel, Zimmer, Dentsply Sirona are generally preferable).
- How they handle complications and warranty policies.
- Sedation/anesthesia options and infection control.
- Good communication and time to explain alternatives.

Questions to ask at a consult
- How many similar implants have you placed? What is your success/complication rate?
- Will you do the surgery and the restoration, or will I see two different doctors?
- Which implant brand and why?
- Will I need bone grafting or sinus lift?
- Timeline from surgery to final crown?
- Can I see before/after cases and patient reviews?

Resources to use
- ABOMS (aboms.org) for oral surgeons
- American Academy of Periodontology (perio.org)
- American College of Prosthodontists (prosthodontics.org)
- Google/Healthgrades/Zocdoc/Yelp/RealSelf for reviews and patient experiences

If you’d like, I can:
- Find several top‑rated implant doctors near your Houston ZIP/neighborhood and summarize credentials, ratings, and contact info.
- Prepare a short list of questions tailored to your situation (single tooth, full arch, budget, medical conditions).

Tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood and whether this is a single tooth or a larger restoration (and any insurance/medical considerations), and I’ll pull candidates and next steps for you.
